metaTitle: Event flowers and decor in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah
metaDescription: Entrances, centrepieces and stage florals for weddings, launches, conferences and dinners, installed before your doors open and removed afterwards.
title: Event florals, installed before your doors open
lead: Entrances, centrepieces and stage florals for dinners, launches, conferences and weddings in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah.

1.title: Entrances and arches
1.body: A first impression that guests walk through, installed and removed by our team.

2.title: Table centrepieces
2.body: Low pieces that keep conversation open, or tall ones that draw the eye up in large rooms.

3.title: Stage and backdrops
3.body: Floral walls and foliage frames built to the width of your stage.

4.title: Vessels and rentals
4.body: Matching glass vases for three days, with a refundable deposit.

looksBody: Starting points for the room. We adapt each to your palette and venue.
piecesBody: Priced per piece, with lead times shown before you order.

1.title: Share the brief
1.body: Date, venue, guest count and rough budget, ideally four weeks out.

2.title: Confirm the plan
2.body: Palette, pieces and venue access, with a written quote.

3.title: Lock the numbers
3.body: Final counts, delivery and install times one week before.

4.title: Install and remove
4.body: We install before your doors open and clear florals and rented vessels afterwards.

enquiryBody: Share the date and the room. We reply to discuss the details, usually within one working day.
